items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: I think it was Bill Kleppinger. He was one of his good friends.

ctx.x: Well he was originally a guitarist with the string group, wasn't he?

Yeah. It was Monk played the guitar. I remember he had a hell of a fine guitar. Somebody had bought over in Italy and brought to this country. I think it was Bill Kleppinger. He was one of his good friends. I think Bill lived at his house. He was living on Napoleon and Ronaldette I believe it was. We had quite a vogue at one time. I don't know how it got started, but a few years in there we played for practically all the fraternity parties around Tulane and most of the balls. The carnival season was just getting…
On the uptown riverside there? Yeah. Another one near the environment. A little Victorian. That's a nice house.
